Big news I’m realllllllllllllyyyyyyy proud to share :blue_heart:

Today, we announced that 365Talents is joining forces with Docebo.

For me, this is about taking a belief we’ve had since I joined in 2020 — skills first — and giving it the scale it deserves.

Skills are powerful on their own.

Skills + learning? That’s where real impact happens.

Excited to work with the Docebo team to build the best of Skills + Learning, and very proud of what the 365Talents team has built to get us here.

More to come :rocket:
